lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 11 distinct white vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is irregular, with wider intervals in the mid-section (~80-100 pixels) and increased density toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Significant discontinuities observed in the first, third, and fifth lines from the shoulder, which terminate mid-flank before reaching the dorsal or ventral boundaries.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit an initial posterior-lateral sweep from the pedicle, transitioning into a sharp dorsal lyrate curve with a terminal medial orientation.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 1.7 times the width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips comprise approximately 10-15% of the total longitudinal horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the orbital regions and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area.
